cards.guidance: Lead with the key fact; vary phrasing, not meaning. No extra events or predictions.
Build tension from the supplied chase only; never invent a shrinking gap or completed pass.
cards.example_en: Example: {target} is the target as he closes in.
cards.example_cs: Příklad: Cílem je {target}, postupně se k němu dotahuje.

cards.guidance: Describe the supplied rear pressure without guessing a pass or trend.
cards.example_en: Example: Pressure in the mirrors, with {target} right behind him.
cards.example_cs: Příklad: Tlak v zrcátkách, {target} se drží za ním.

cards.guidance: Contrast the attack ahead with pressure behind; both named roles must remain explicit.
cards.example_en: Example: His attack targets {front} ahead, with {rear} applying pressure behind.
cards.example_cs: Příklad: Jeho útok míří na jezdce {front} vpředu, zatímco {rear} tlačí zezadu.

cards.guidance: Start with the hero's attack, then turn to the rear threat.
cards.example_en: Example: He attacks {front} up front, but {rear} keeps the pressure on from behind.
cards.example_cs: Příklad: Vpředu útočí na jezdce {front}, ale {rear} mu zezadu nedává klid.

cards.guidance: Start with pressure from the rear driver, then name the attack ahead.
cards.example_en: Example: {rear} pressures him from behind while his attack targets {front} ahead.
cards.example_cs: Příklad: {rear} tlačí zezadu, zatímco on vpředu útočí na jezdce {front}.

cards.guidance: State the confirmed position change. Do not guess its cause or an on-track pass.
cards.example_en: Example: A place lost leaves him in P{position}.
cards.example_cs: Příklad: Ztráta pozice ho posouvá na {position}. místo.

cards.guidance: Describe the position gain without guessing a cause or on-track pass.
cards.example_en: Example: He gains a place to move into P{position}.
cards.example_cs: Příklad: Získává pozici a posouvá se na {position}. místo.

cards.guidance: Close with the supplied result only. No invented podium, celebration or final classification.
cards.example_en: Fact: His race is complete. Call: That brings his race to a close.
cards.example_cs: Fakt: Jeho závod skončil. Komentář: Tím se jeho závod uzavírá.
